title: Quant profile onboarding stability scorer and deployment safeguard
creator: Riley Chen
description: Introduce a Stability Scorer and deployment safeguard to make quantized model profile onboarding (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) safe for production. The scorer aggregates multi-dimensional signals (inference latency distribution, token-level accuracy deltas on keyed prompt sets, sampling entropy divergence, and cost-per-token) into a single stability score used to gate automated promotion, routing weight shifts, and pin propagation. This ticket implements the scorer, integrates it into the existing intake pipeline, and adds a blue/green-style staged rollout with automatic rollback thresholds and an operator dashboard. Goals: a) detect subtle perf/quality regressions that current smoke checks miss, b) reduce manual vetting time for precision variants, c) provide deterministic rollback when SLOs deviate.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Stability Scorer component accepts a quant profile artifact and outputs a stability_score (0-100) and a breakdown for: accuracy_delta, p95_latency_regression, cost_delta, entropy_divergence. 2) Profiles with score >= 85 auto-enter a staged rollout; scores 65-84 require manual approval; <65 are rejected. 3) Staged rollout supports traffic slicing (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) with automated rollback if any metric exceeds configured thresholds. 4) Dashboards show scorer breakdown, historical scores per model+profile, and can trigger alerts. 5) End-to-end tests and canary harness validate at least three representative models (one large decoder-only, one encoder-decoder, one sparse-MLP) and run nightly to detect drift.
tasks: Design stability scoring algorithm and weight scheme (accuracy 40%, latency 30%, cost 15%, entropy 15%)
Implement scorer microservice with REST API and provenance metadata output
Wire scorer into quant intake pipeline (post-calibration stage)
Extend rollout controller to accept scorer-driven gating and graded traffic shifts
Add rollback rules: absolute accuracy drop >1.5% OR p95 latency regress >40% OR cost increase >20% triggers immediate rollback
Create canary prompt set for synthetic and production-seeded checks (store as immutable artifact)
Implement dashboard panels and alert rules in Console (per-profile historical view)
Add e2e tests and nightly scheduled runs for three model families
Document operator runbook and publish to Confluence
Create CI gate to reject profiles that have missing telemetry hooks

links: Related ticket: ENG-40227 (profiling gate and metric contract)
telemetry_metrics: accuracy_delta_pct (percent change vs baseline on golden prompt set)
kl_divergence_entropy (avg KL between distributions on sampled prompts)
testing_plan: Unit tests for scoring math and normalization, integration tests that run full intake+rollout controller in staging, and nightly regression job that runs the canary prompt set across INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ variants for three model families. Failure on any nightly run creates an automated investigation ticket with attached artifacts (samples, latencies, diffs).
rollout_plan: 1) Candidate profile created in staging. 2) Scorer evaluates and outputs score with breakdown. 3) If score >=85, start staged rollout: 1% -> wait 30m -> 5% -> wait 1h -> 25% -> wait 3h -> 100%. At each step evaluate metrics; if any metric breaches rollback thresholds, shift traffic back to previous stable pin and mark profile as rejected. 4) Profiles 65-84 land in 'manual review' queue for SRE/PM sign-off. 5) All promotions create immutable release notes and artifacts pinned in the profile registry.
operator_runbook: Steps to pause rollout, force-rollback, and manually promote profiles. Includes runbook commands, logs to inspect, dashboards to consult, and contact matrix. Published in Confluence link in Links section.
notes: This ticket intentionally separates the scorer from the final promotion decision to allow teams to iterate on weights and thresholds without changing orchestration. Expect follow-ups to add ML-driven adaptive weights and per-customer sensitivity tuning.
